text:
sam: Heads-up - OOM on shard-prod-21 at 01:23 UTC. Symptoms appear to be a recurring leakage pattern but with a twist: we see a sudden rise in mid-sized object residency after rolling compaction. Logs & short heap dump: https://logs.company/oom/1739991234

ira: paste the heap tail?

sam: brief from heapwatch:
```
heap.total_mb: 24576
heap.used_mb: 15420 -> 23110 (5h)
kv.residency.count: 900k -> 3.6M
kv.mid_size_bucket.count (256-1024B): 120k -> 820k
gc.pause.p95: 18ms -> 62ms
last.full-compact: 00:30 UTC
```

lena: interesting. mid-size bucket explosion suggests allocation site churn, maybe emergent use of batch-upserts. i'll take alloc-site tracing and histogram diffs. target: reproduce in staging and list top 10 alloc callsites. due Tue EOD.

matt: i'll own runtime knobs: experiment with async-free window and incremental compaction thresholds. will run 3 configs in staging and compare p95 pauses and residency growth. due Thu.

toni: i'll coordinate canary soft-evict but propose adding API-rate guard for bulk-write endpoints to prevent sudden spikes. i'll prototype a per-key write quota as a quick mitigation. due Fri.

sam: please write concrete action items so I can paste into the postmortem tracker. short bullets pls.

lena: Action: alloc-site tracing + top-10 histograms -> owner: lena -> due: 2026-03-29 EOD -> success: reproduce mid-size bucket growth in staging and attach callsite list to INF-4899

matt: Action: runtime GC experiments (async-free / incremental compaction) -> owner: matt -> due: 2026-03-31 -> success: config that reduces p95 GC pause by >=25% without increasing tail latency

toni: Action: canary soft-evict + per-key write quota prototype -> owner: toni -> due: 2026-04-02 -> success: no more than 1% error rate in canary, and peak residency reduced >=15%

ira: Action: nightly hot-key snapshot job + weekly regression report -> owner: ira -> due: 2026-03-26 -> success: snapshots available in /data/residency-snapshots and weekly report scheduled in ops calendar

sam: Action: update postmortem tracker with owners, dashboards, and retro invite -> owner: sam -> due: 2026-03-25 -> success: INF-4899 updated, calendar invite for retro created

ops-bot: Created issue: INF-4899 - "Mid-size KV residency surge after compaction / OOM followups" (https://jira.company/browse/INF-4899). Assigned: lena, matt, toni, ira, sam.

lena: note: before heavy canary changes, i'll run the staging replay with the new synthetic "batch-upsert-heavy" script. i'll push branch to tests repo: https://git.company/tests/kv-batch-upsert-sim

matt: i'll parameterize three GC configs and tag them in staging runs: g1(async-free=on, compaction=low), g2(async-free=off, compaction=incremental-high), g3(async-free=on, compaction=incremental-medium). will attach perf matrix to INF-4899.

toni: per-key write quota prototype sketch: limit 50 writes/min per key with a short token-bucket; will run it as a temporary middleware in canary. if it helps, we can consider a server-side soft-reject with informative error so clients can backoff.

ira: nightly snapshot job: I'll add a small lambda to capture top-100 keys by residency and histogram deltas and put into S3. also wiring an alert if any key grows >2x in 6h.

sam: scheduling a 30m retro for 2026-04-03 10:00 PST to review findings and decide long-term mitigations (eviction heuristics, allocator-level fixes, API contracts). invite will go to eng-runtime + infra leads.

ops-bot: Incident note appended to INF-4899: "Variant observed: mid-size object residency spike after compaction; follow-ups created; staging canaries and GC experiments planned."

lena: starting tracing run in staging now. will attach flamegraphs and alloc histograms by Tue EOD.

matt: kicking off GC experiments. tagging runs with run-id: gc-exp-4899.

toni: canary middleware deployed to 2 nodes in staging. monitoring for false positive rejects.

ira: snapshot job added to cron. first snapshot saved to s3://residency-snapshots/1739991234-first-run.json.

sam: thanks team. please paste PR links, dashboards, and experiment artifacts into INF-4899. i'll collate nightly notes and post to #eng-oncall for the week.

lena: will post callsite PRs and initial findings by Tue.

matt: aiming to publish perf matrix by Thu.

toni: will report canary behavior after 24h and final by Fri.

sam: end.
